title: ATOMCI: a non-relativistic configuration interaction program for many-electron atoms
description: ATOMCI computes non-relativistic configuration interaction wave functions and energies of many-electron atoms in the Russell-Saunders (LS) coupling scheme. It was developed at Hokkaido University; this release builds and runs on current Fortran compilers.
